findings: S2: 01-PRD carries 10 must-have features against the 3-6 the check describes. The companion-backed variant b band is 6-10 (generate_instruction); the out-of-scope list the check names as its FAIL trigger is present.

A1: `## Build plan` is absent and `## Front-end specification` is present. Variant b withholds Build plan on the spec_sections axis and the companion adds the front-end section, both recorded in _spec/00-decisions.md. window_lint (G33) passes on the section set.

C7: `## Core features` is 17756 chars against a 2400 target, so the run_rubric judge sees only its first 2500. window_lint (G33) passes: the brief carries no length limit. Mitigated because every judged criterion carries its own facts rather than pointing at the brief (G52 PASS), so the judge does not depend on the excerpt.

D2: `## UI/UX notes` states `There is no bounce, no overshoot` of interface motion while `Atmosphere` gives each bird `an overshoot on the recovery` of its wing flap. Two different subjects; neither is on the graded surface, so this is a readability risk rather than a graded ambiguity.

D4 [warn]: `## Data model` reads `so a grader can sign in`. It names an external checker but does not locate it outside the app by naming a backing service it inspects, so it sits below the stated BLOCKER bar. Recorded rather than rewritten (Q4: the audit flags, the author fixes).
